Effect EFFECT_FOLLOW_FLIP_ALPHA: the donor pushes 16 Lua values; the smash-script macro takes 13. The unit pushes all 16 (the last three are 0, 0, false).

Rumble kind rbkind_nohitm and rumble u32 0x50000000 are exact donor values. The P16 forward tilt uses rbkind_nohits (a different hash, see research) and 0 for that u32 (the donor passes 0x50000000).
